Name: Cleaner Island Tiles
Author: DeLiXxN
Description:
This is a tiny tilesheet composed of random tiles I wanted for my custom farms, though it's mostly cleaned up and seasonally recolored Island tiles.

By default this mod will also seasonally recolor palm trees when in the valley.

Feel free to add this as a dependency should you decide to use it for your own project.

[b]Compatible Recolors:[/b]

* [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5255/]DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour
[/url]* [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367?tab=files]Vibrant Pastoral Recolor (VPR)[/url]﻿

Thanks go out to Airyn for helping out with the fall Palette
